summary: This Layer 1B pass expands a speculative second-order node around energy supplier-risk visibility, utility asset resilience, testing/certification, and procurement/operations analytics. The investable US-listed map is fragmented: pure-play energy supplier-risk software appears scarce, so the strongest public candidates cluster in adjacent lanes: supplier-risk data platforms, electrical testing/certification, grid-edge utility analytics, and utility infrastructure inspection/geospatial services. The underfollowed lane is most plausible in ITRI and NVEE, while SPGI and ULS serve as higher-attention reference anchors for supplier-risk intelligence and certification bottlenecks.
